verdict.rationale: Smooth documents programmatic session management through its REST API: you can create persistent browser sessions, list tasks, cancel running tasks, and send session actions including `close`. Nothing in the evidence shows running many sessions in parallel or any published concurrency limits, and the session docs describe sequential tasks within one browser instance. Missing for 10: documented concurrent/parallel session support, published concurrency limits or quotas, fleet-level orchestration guidance, independent corroboration of running at scale.
